name: Banana Pudding Chessmen Ice Cream Sandwiches
desc: Blue Bell banana pudding ice cream frozen between two layers of Chessmen butter cookies and cut into squares.

source.title: Banana Pudding Chessmen Ice Cream Sandwiches
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 (7.25 oz) bags Pepperidge Farm Chessmen cookies
1 quart Blue Bell Banana Pudding ice cream (about half a 64 fl oz carton)
ingredients.item: Blue Bell Banana Pudding ice cream
ingredients.note: about half a 64 fl oz carton

steps: Spray an 8x8 in square pan and line it with parchment, leaving an overhang on two sides.
Lay a tight single layer of Chessmen on the bottom, pattern side down, breaking cookies to fill gaps.
Let the ice cream sit on the counter 10-15 min until spreadable. Spread it over the cookies to the thickness you like (about 1 in) and smooth the top.
Top with another layer of cookies, pattern side up, pressing gently.
Cover and freeze overnight, at least 8 hr.
Lift the slab out by the parchment and cut into squares with a heavy knife warmed under hot water and wiped dry. Serve right away or wrap and keep frozen.
tips: Store them in the freezer. In the fridge the ice cream melts.
The pan size and ice cream amount are estimates; the reel uses a square pan and spreads the ice cream to any thickness.
